long_biography.plain_text:
Jürgen Grossmann's work on the European Forum am Rhein brought together property development, public space and architecture on the German-French border. His projects have also encompassed the Illenau complex in Achern, the former barracks in Lahr and historic buildings around Offenburg. Trained in architecture in Paris and Karlsruhe, he combines building design with decisions about how land and existing structures can be used.

Grossmann leads a group that brings architects, developers, property specialists and interior designers into the same projects. He holds its central company outright while directing property-development and design businesses alongside it. His work favours previously developed land and the preservation of older buildings. One project turned a former prison in Offenburg into a hotel.
